text: A 1998 paper estimated how much global rotation would be needed to dominate the origin of galaxy spins. We scale down from that published benchmark in the simplest linear way, and we assume later scrambling erases nothing. Both choices favor the model. Even then, the largest allowed handedness imbalance is about 5 galaxies in 10 million. This is an upper-edge estimate, not a precise forecast from the original rotating parent source.
